# Nestform 0.4.0

Nestform 0.4.0 is the first client-ready Windows release maintained by Kirsten Trimaley, trading as Yaze Media. It combines the preserved Deepnest nesting engine with the Workshop Dark interface, Auto Nest, multiple sheets and offcuts, millimetre-based workflows, local History backups, guided onboarding, and expanded appearance controls.

## Install

Use `Nestform-Setup-0.4.0.exe` for the normal Windows installation. `Nestform-0.4.0-Windows.exe` is the portable build. Verify either download with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

These executables are not Authenticode signed, so Windows may display an **Unknown publisher** or Microsoft Defender SmartScreen warning.

## Licence and source

Nestform is a GPL-3.0-only fork of Deepnest by Jack Qiao. The release includes `Nestform-0.4.0-Source.zip`, the matching complete source bundle and build input for the distributed binaries. Copyright and third-party ownership remain identified in the included notices.

The Nestform name is provisional and is not represented as a registered trade mark.

## Validation limits

The release tests native parity, SVG import and export, Auto Nest defaults, multiple stock pieces, History, and measured millimetre spacing on reference fixtures. Conversion-dependent CDR and DXF compatibility and every possible production drawing have not been universally qualified. Inspect output dimensions and run a safe material test before production.
